proof_summary: Jointly order the points \(n/5\), \(n/\varphi\), and \(n/(1/\varphi)\); irrationality of \(\varphi\) (together with \(1/\varphi=\varphi-1\)) shows that no two such points coincide. The cumulative count \(\sum_i\lfloor d_i x\rfloor\) increases by exactly one at each next point, so the resulting ranks exhaust the positive integers uniquely, and evaluating the ranks gives the three floor formulas.
